questions.a: THE CHAIN IS CLOSED: five stones, each fired individually by Akien, all cast and PROVED within the same arc — graph-tree store, core loop, library+learn, summarizer, chat surface. The first face is whole: a human can open a browser, ask, and every answer comes from structure.

THE FIRST LIVE CONVERSATION (through the browser door, library tree): (1) asked why Akien wanted an audit agent — RESOLVED by walk alone at 0.6772, ZERO backfills, and stone 4's landed summary rode the walk mid-rank as ordinary structure (the deposit-back earning its keep in the very next session); (2) 'summarize: the audit agent and watchdog ideas...' rendered cited prose from 8 of 34 nodes — two shelved passages and four backfill mints, each citation legible by source; (3) a question the library tree genuinely lacks (the hex payback meter) backfilled three path-shaped mints and RESOLVED at 0.8295 on them.

EDGE (l)'s SECOND FACE, MEASURED: home-field advantage does not just outrank real nodes — it can MANUFACTURE resolution where the graph held nothing. The payback-meter mints were content-wrong about the actual idea, yet satisfied the floor because they were born question-shaped. Traceable throughout (source: llm-backfill, standing: hypothesis), so the verdict is honest about its sources — but a consumer reading only the verdict line would call it answered. Filed on the librarian charter (edge l, second face) with a third customer for the tenure loop: cross-tree resolution (the founding tree COULD have answered that question).

THE CARRIER WAS ALREADY TRUE: web_server's charter (2026-07-22) said the librarian's web interface 'falls out of the chatbot only if the surface exists first' — five days later the chat window landed as its filed edge (c)'s first rich view: a PANE the standard machinery renders on the librarian's own page.

CC-- 2026-07-28, THE CARRIER WAS FIRST BUILT WRONG-SHAPED: the first cast wired chat as a bespoke /chat route with an injected chat_source — a parallel door, when the ratified design already had the machinery (Akien, verbatim: 'there should be ONLY EVER ONE WEB SERVER IN THE WHOLE SYSTEM... the librarian would have a page it manages that the extant web server would display. it's chat window is supposed to be in the surfaces the base shim class understands' — and 'the shims job is to start it's device if it's not running'). Corrected same-day to the pane + shim shape; the /chat route removed (a proof tooth now pins that it 404s); daemon.py renamed listener.py with the NO DAEMONS law stated in its charter-docstring (it acts only on external calls — UU's daemon sprawl is WHY the ground loop owns the one heartbeat). The drift's shape: I paralleled the harbor exception (a fleet-wide injected view) for what is really a DEVICE surface — the harbor route is the exception, the pane machinery is the rule.

A LIVE REFUSAL EXPOSED A PARSER DEFECT (found by the corrected shape's live fire, 2026-07-28): qwen2.5:7b cited [1, 6] — comma-grouped, one bracket, two anchors — and the single-number marker pattern refused a genuinely anchored draft as 'anchors to nothing'. Fixed as the fence precedent: grouping is a presentation quirk, not content ([1, 6] anchors passages 1 and 6; an out-of-range member of a group is still a minted citation — new tooth pins both). The re-fire consumed the CACHED draft and landed cited prose with zero new inference: the fix turned a cached refusal into a cached success (Law 1 whole through a bug fix).
